642bb4f5e9b1a832.description: Job Summary: We are looking for a motivated Junior Java Microservices Developer to join our software development team and contribute to building, developing, and maintaining scalable backend applications using Java and Microservices architecture. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of Java programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, and basic knowledge of Spring Boot and RESTful APIs, with a strong willingness to learn and grow within a collaborative development environment. Key Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and enhance backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. Assist in designing and implementing microservices-based applications. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and web services. Write clean, reusable, efficient, and maintainable code. Work with relational and NoSQL databases to perform data operations. Collaborate with senior developers, software architects, QA engineers, and business analysts. Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues. Assist in implementing application security, authentication, and authorization mechanisms. Participate in unit testing and integration testing. Work with Git and CI/CD pipelines to support development and deployment activities. Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement initiatives. Job Requirements: 0–2 years of experience in Java development. Good knowledge of Java programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. Basic understanding of Spring Framework and Spring Boot. Familiarity with Microservices architecture and its core concepts. Basic experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs. Understanding of SQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Familiarity with Hibernate and JPA is a plus. Basic knowledge of data structures and algorithms. Familiarity with Git and version control systems. Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC). Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a team. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. Basic understanding of Docker and containerization. Exposure to Kubernetes is a plus. Familiarity with JUnit and Mockito for unit testing. Basic knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Academic, internship, or personal project experience involving Java and Spring Boot microservices.

Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients and key accounts. Conduct client meetings, business presentations, and commercial negotiations. 645c41430a2d206d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اسعد عبدالرحمن الاهدل للنقليات عن سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والتنظيمي للمدير/الرئيس، مما يضمن سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل مستمر. التعامل مع الاستفسارات الواردة والرد عليها، بالإضافة إلى إيصال البريد والمراسلات إلى المدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية وتلك المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات وتسجيل محاضرها وتحريرها بدقة. حفظ الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس بطريقة منظمة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو دور إداري مشابه. القدرة على تنظيم المواعيد وإدارة المهام المتعددة بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد المذكرات والمراسلات الرسمية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية قوية باللغة العربية. القدرة على حفظ الوثائق والملفات بطريقة منظمة وسهلة الوصول. الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير وتحرير المحاضر. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مؤسسة اسعد عبدالرحمن الاهدل للنقليات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في المكتب لتقديم الدعم الإداري المباشر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقًا.

64a13ec0f8e8281d.description: About WSP in the Middle East WSP in the Middle East is seeking a Quality Inspector to join its project supervision team in Riyadh, Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on ensuring construction activities comply with established quality standards and project specifications. Role Overview The Quality Inspector will be responsible for monitoring construction activities, materials, and workmanship to ensure adherence to approved drawings, project specifications, quality requirements, and applicable standards. The role involves regular site inspections and comprehensive quality assurance documentation. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Inspect construction materials, workmanship, and completed works against approved requirements. Review Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, material approvals, and relevant QA/QC documentation. Witness inspections, testing activities, and material sampling as required. Raise and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and site observations. Verify corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely close-out of quality issues. Monitor contractors’ compliance with approved QA/QC procedures and project Quality Plans. Coordinate with engineers, contractors, laboratories, and other project stakeholders regarding quality matters. Maintain accurate inspection records, checklists, quality reports, and supporting documentation. Support audits and ensure proper implementation of project quality procedures. Identify recurring quality issues and report areas requiring corrective action. Ensure works comply with relevant contractual, regulatory, and project-specific requirements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in quality inspection within construction projects. Work Setting This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, within a project supervision team environment. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of commercial negotiations, contract development, and vendor relationships. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to make decisive decisions that drive organizational value. The manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, mitigate risks, and optimize commercial outcomes. Key Responsibilities Negotiate, draft, review, and execute commercial contracts with vendors, suppliers, and business partners, ensuring legal compliance and organizational protection. Develop and implement commercial strategies that align with organizational objectives and maximize profitability. Analyze contract terms, conditions, and financial implications to identify risks and opportunities for cost optimization. Manage vendor and supplier relationships, including performance monitoring, issue resolution, and ongoing communication. 64ad4a19f86eb45a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كفاءة البنيان للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، بالالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الميكانيكية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التصميم الهندسي والتحليل. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفنية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية فعالة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الأقسام المختلفة. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركة كفاءة البنيان للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل احترافية تركز على الجودة والكفاءة في تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

64df867777107617.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سنترال التجارية عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وضمان رضاهم من خلال تحليل الأداء وتحديد نقاط التحسين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة لخدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، ومتابعتها لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم، واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات تهدف إلى تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات العملاء من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، لبناء نموذج متكامل للخدمة. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل رضا العملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة كتابة وشفوياً. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تحسين تجربة العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

6452a2f4a9924809.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a qualified and experienced Horticulturalist – Indoor Gardens to join the KAUST Beacon Development team. This full-time role focuses on supporting the development and maintenance of high-quality indoor and outdoor garden environments. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience in horticulture. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute daily horticulture activities across indoor and outdoor garden environments. Plant, establish, maintain, prune, propagate, replace, and care for a diverse range of plants. Maintain trees, shrubs, groundcovers, herbaceous plants, seasonal displays, and indoor plant collections. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience as a horticulture professional. Demonstrated expertise in maintaining diverse indoor and outdoor plant collections. Proficiency in plant health monitoring and pest management. Work Type This is a full-time position.

6415e053d64f00e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاجير للموارد البشرية عن محصل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. يهدف المحصل إلى إدارة وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة بفعالية، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد كشوفات تفصيلية بالمبالغ المستحقة من الجهات المختلفة والعمل على تحصيلها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. متابعة وتنسيق الجهود مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحصيل المبالغ النقدية، والرد على استفساراتهم وأسئلتهم المتعلقة بالتحصيل. تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وتحديث الكشوفات بشكل مستمر، مع الالتزام التام بتعليمات سرية المعاملات المالية والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. الالتزام الكامل بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لأعمال تحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. حفظ النسخ الورقية من سندات القبض والوثائق ذات الصلة، وترتيبها وتخزينها بما يتوافق مع السياسات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التحصيل أو ما شابه. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات المالية بدقة واحترافية. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية والخارجية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الجهات المختلفة. القدرة على تنظيم العمل وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل البيانات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق يدعم تحقيق الأهداف المالية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

6485921689a45094.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة قناص العربية عن طاهي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى الطاهي مسؤولية استلام المواد الأولية، وتجهيزها، وطهيها، وتحضيرها للتقديم في بيئة عمل متكاملة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الأولية وتجهيزها وتحضيرها لطهي اللحوم والدجاج والخضراوات والأسماك وغيرها من الأطعمة. طهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطباق المدرجة في قائمة الطعام، بما في ذلك الشوربات والسلطات والمقبلات الباردة والساخنة. إعداد وطهي الأطعمة الشرقية المختلفة. تجهيز الأكلات بعد نضوجها ووضعها في الأواني المناسبة وتحضيرها للتقديم. متابعة إجراءات تنظيف المطبخ والأدوات، والإشراف على نظافة أدوات الطبخ والطعام. المحافظة على إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة العامة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الطهي. القدرة على التعامل مع مختلف أنواع الأطعمة والمكونات. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. بيئة العمل يعمل الطاهي ضمن فريق في شركة قناص العربية بالرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المطبخ لتنفيذ المهام اليومية. عن شركة قناص العربية تلتزم شركة قناص العربية بتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة في مجالها، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا كطاهي في الرياض، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

64e74cacf2c07156.description: About the Role Aroma City Group is seeking an experienced Environmental Officer to join their team. This full-time position involves overseeing environmental compliance and management for large-scale infrastructure projects in Saudi Arabia. The role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in environmental management within an engineering consultancy setting. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor the environmental management plan for large-scale infrastructure works. Conduct site inspections and audits to ensure compliance with environmental permits and regulations. Monitor and report on dust, noise, air, water, and waste management. Review contractor environmental plans and method statements. Investigate environmental incidents and follow up on corrective actions. Coordinate with authorities and prepare comprehensive environmental reports. Deliver environmental awareness sessions and toolbox talks to project teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in environmental management, preferably within an engineering consultancy. Demonstrated experience in implementing and monitoring environmental management plans on large-scale infrastructure projects. Strong understanding of environmental permits and regulations. Required Skills Proficiency in conducting environmental site inspections and audits. Ability to monitor and report on various environmental parameters (dust, noise, air, water, waste). Strong analytical skills for reviewing environmental plans and investigating incidents. Excellent communication and coordination skills for liaising with authorities and delivering training. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

64f7c9cc272c5bf7.job_title: Senior Assistant Engineer - Technical Advisory Support (Saudi Arabia)
64f7c9cc272c5bf7.description: We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Assistant Engineer to support the Technical Advisory team in providing engineering research, technical analysis, project assessments, and business support to senior management. The role involves collecting and analysing technical information, preparing reports and presentations, supporting project planning, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to facilitate informed management decisions and ensure alignment with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Conduct technical research and collect engineering information from various sources. Analyse technical and business data and prepare findings to support management decision-making. Assist in preparing technical reports, project assessments, and project justifications. Prepare presentations and supporting materials for senior management meetings. Support the preparation, review, and updating of master plans and departmental work plans. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to address technical challenges and follow up on assigned activities. Assist in reviewing project plans and coordinating necessary adjustments when requirements change. Provide administrative and technical support to senior management and the Technical Advisory team. Maintain and develop technical knowledge relevant to assigned engineering activities. Associate Degree in Engineering or any other relevant technical discipline. Bachelor's Degree is preferred. 3 years of relevant professional experience. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Basic understanding of technical research, data analysis, and report preparation. Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical, organizational, and coordination skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

6407385ce1dcdf7d.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Director – Playing Surfaces & Landscaping to lead the strategy, design, delivery and long-term management of world-class playing surfaces and landscaped environments across Qiddiya’s growing Sports portfolio. This is a highly technical leadership role covering major stadiums, training facilities, indoor and covered venues, competition and community pitches, public realm and extensive landscaped areas. The successful candidate will establish consistent technical and performance standards across natural, hybrid and synthetic playing surfaces, ensuring they meet the requirements of elite athletes, international competitions and major sporting events. A key focus will be developing and maintaining premium-quality natural grass in Saudi Arabia’s challenging climate, including extreme heat, water constraints and the shaded or controlled conditions found within stadiums and indoor environments. The role will provide specialist input throughout design, construction, testing, commissioning and operations, ensuring every surface is safe, resilient, sustainable and operationally fit for purpose. Key responsibilities will include: Develop and lead the playing surfaces and landscaping strategy across Qiddiya’s Sports assets. Establish technical, operational and performance standards for stadiums, training facilities, indoor or covered venues and landscaped environments. Provide specialist input into venue design, ensuring roofing, shading, airflow, lighting, drainage, irrigation and operational requirements support optimum growing conditions. Lead the selection, design, construction and management of natural, hybrid and synthetic playing surfaces. Oversee pitch construction, turf establishment, testing, renovation, resurfacing and replacement programmes. Develop technical solutions for growing and maintaining elite sports turf in extreme heat, shaded stadiums and controlled indoor environments. Direct the design and performance of irrigation, drainage, soil profiles, root zones, grow-lighting and specialist turf-management systems. Establish agronomic and maintenance programmes covering grass selection, nutrition, moisture management, mowing, aeration, disease control and seasonal transition. Ensure playing surfaces meet the standards of relevant international sports federations and governing bodies. Develop pitch-protection, conversion and recovery plans to support demanding sporting and entertainment event schedules. Lead landscaping strategy across sports assets, including public realm, ornamental planting and climate-resilient landscape solutions. Manage commissioning and operational readiness, ensuring teams, equipment, materials, procedures and contingency plans are in place before venue opening. Build and lead multidisciplinary teams of grounds professionals, agronomists, landscapers, irrigation specialists, mechanics and technical staff. Oversee specialist suppliers, consultants and contractors, setting clear standards and performance measures. Manage capital and operational budgets, procurement strategies and lifecycle replacement plans. Drive sustainable practices through efficient water use, climate-appropriate planting, environmentally responsible materials and emerging turf technology. Bachelor’s degree, diploma or equivalent professional qualification in Sports Turf Management, Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant Science, Landscape Management or a related discipline. Extensive senior-level experience leading playing surface, sports turf and landscaping operations within major stadiums, professional sports organisations, international tournaments or large sports destinations. Proven experience delivering competition-standard playing surfaces for elite domestic and international sporting events. Deep technical knowledge of natural, hybrid and synthetic surfaces, turfgrass science, agronomy, irrigation, drainage, soil and root-zone construction, grow-lighting and specialist machinery. Demonstrable experience growing and maintaining high-performance natural grass in challenging climates or technically complex stadium environments. Experience working across stadiums, training facilities and indoor or covered venues with restricted sunlight, airflow or growing conditions. Strong experience supporting major venue projects through planning, design, construction, commissioning, handover and operations. Detailed understanding of how stadium architecture, roofing, shading, ventilation, lighting and event operations affect playing-surface performance. Experience managing significant landscaped estates, public realm or high-profile ornamental environments. Knowledge of international sports federation requirements and surface testing standards. Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary and multicultural teams while developing local technical capability. Strong commercial experience, including capital and operational budgets, procurement, contractor management and lifecycle planning. Ability to advise senior executives, designers, engineers, contractors and operational teams on complex technical matters. Professional certification or membership with a recognised international sports-turf, agronomy, grounds-management or horticultural body would be advantageous. Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills

643a8d27f48515d8.description: About the Role SYSTRA is seeking a Track Alignment Engineer (Design) to join our team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves extending PMC services for a major client, focusing on leading and assuring track alignment design for rail projects. The position requires aligning multidisciplinary interfaces and ensuring project delivery meets client standards. Role Context and Objectives The Track Alignment Engineer will contribute to rail projects by specializing in the geometric design of tracks. This includes reviewing horizontal and vertical alignments, defining design criteria, and conducting optimization studies. The role ensures compliance with international and regional rail standards while integrating considerations for RAMS, maintainability, and ride quality. Key Responsibilities Support the Engineering Lead in reviewing horizontal and vertical alignment designs for mainline, depot, and yard tracks using industry-standard tools such as Bentley OpenRail, Civil 3D, and MX. Define and enforce geometric design criteria, alignment control parameters, and tolerances across all project phases (concept, preliminary, detailed design). Conduct design checks, optioneering, and value engineering for alignments, turnouts, crossovers, and transition curves to optimize performance, maintainability, and cost. Ensure compliance with international and regional rail standards and client-specific requirements, integrating RAMS, maintainability, and ride quality considerations. Act as the integrated PMC representative to the client, coordinating multi-disciplinary interfaces including civil, structures, trackwork, OCS, signaling, drainage, and utilities. Manage technical queries, change requests, and design approvals, maintaining clear audit trails and configuration control. Lead design risk management for alignment choices, considering ground conditions, utilities, third-party constraints, and environmental factors. Oversee contractor and designer performance on alignment deliverables, ensuring adherence to baseline schedule and quality. Maintain design schedules, registers, and progress reporting for alignment-related works. Prepare and present technical reports, design review comments, and decision logs to client stakeholders. Ensure constructability and staging are embedded in alignment design, supporting site teams during construction and responding to RFIs. Implement robust quality assurance processes, including independent design reviews and verification/validation activities. Align deliverables with KSA authority requirements and applicable standards; support permitting and approvals. Engage with stakeholders, authorities, and third parties to resolve constraints, protect corridors, and secure approvals. Qualifications and Experience A solid design background in track alignment. Over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, working within a project management consultancy (PMC) framework for a major client. Application Information Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

649edd1202885b9a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مشرفه الطبي العام عن أخصائي تقنية إشعاعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمات التصوير الإشعاعي للمرضى، مع ضمان جودة الصور وسلامة الإجراءات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المرضى للتصوير وتهيئتهم وفقاً للأوضاع السليمة، وتحديد واختيار الوسائل الوقائية المناسبة. تشغيل أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي وتفقدها، وتصوير الحالات المختلفة للمرضى والمصابين، مع مراقبة حالتهم أثناء وبعد التصوير. تفقد وتجهيز أجهزة التحميض، ومراجعة الصور، وإجراء التحليل الأولي لضمان جودة التصوير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في تقنيات التصوير بالأشعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتصوير الإشعاعي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال التصوير بالأشعة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تقنية الإشعاع. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة، ويوفر بيئة عمل داعمة في مشرفه الطبي العام. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقدم فرصة للمساهمة في تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم.

64be1cdc160cc809.description: About the Role Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Co. is seeking a SEC Project Coordinator to join their team in Al Khobar. This full-time role is essential for supporting the efficiency and accuracy of service operations, ensuring seamless coordination across scheduling, documentation, and administrative processes within the company's SEC projects. Key Responsibilities Manage document control for all SEC jobs, organizing records by project and customer to ensure easy access and accurate tracking. Ensure the system is regularly updated with all visits, payments, and technical reports to maintain accurate records and enable timely, informed decisions. Facilitate team access to site locations through SEC management and arranging necessary gate passes and IDs. Distribute the workload among the team, referring to committed customer visits to ensure fair and efficient task distribution and timely completion of scheduled visits. Arrange necessary support for the technical team to perform daily work, including materials, spare parts, and documents, to ensure the team is fully equipped and able to execute tasks effectively without delays. Maintain regular communication with customers to foster strong relationships and ensure smooth, coordinated service operations. Handle petty cash and regional expenses to manage day-to-day financial operations accurately and responsibly. Adhere to all company policies and procedures while promoting high standards. Candidate Requirements Flexibility with work requirements, including emergency calls and providing 24/7 customer support. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, requiring a commitment to supporting service operations and customer needs, including outside of standard business hours when necessary.

64ce2f284976b64f.company_name: Clariant Ali Al Abdullah Al Tamimi Co. Ltd
64ce2f284976b64f.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking an HSE Lead to join their team in Rumah (Riyadh Province) and Nairyah (Eastern Province), Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for supervising and implementing the HSE management system at both office and field levels, working closely with power and water plant operations. The HSE Department is responsible for ensuring the full implementation of HSE policies among all employees, contractors, and third parties within plant premises. Key Responsibilities Manage and actively participate in office/plant activities, focusing on overall company objectives and HSE management consistency. Maintain company policies by providing education to all employees and contractors. Develop and implement effective action plans for Corporate HSE programs, including People Based Safety, 5S, Process Safety Review, and Zero Incident processes. Develop and implement annual HSE objectives and targets. Provide advice to all departments on activities such as Task Risk Assessment, Risk Assessment, environmental monitoring, and Incident Investigation. Conduct monthly site HSE committee meetings, ensuring effective member participation in enhancing safety culture and timely closure of actions. Develop a yearly schedule for weekly awareness sessions covering all HSE topics. Lead on-site HSE training programs and awareness sessions for field personnel. Conduct training sessions for employees on HSE procedures and clarify roles and responsibilities. Record and report all incidents, including employee injuries, and follow up on recommendations for effective closure; report timely to corporate HSE function. Manage and implement contractor control procedures, ensuring effective implementation by all concerned departments. Identify non-compliant, incomplete, or substandard procedures for activities involving employees and/or contractors. Promote the permit-to-work system with operations and maintenance employees to ensure safety. Support the Occupational Health Team in all aspects of the post-accident/injury treatment process. Manage and participate in continuous auditing of HSE management systems. Manage and improve unsafe act/condition and near-miss reporting, recording, and investigations, presenting formal reports with management recommendations. Conduct effective analysis and trends for all incidents, Near Misses, Unsafe Act/Conditions, and NCRs, presenting reports to management during HSE Committee Meetings. Develop and implement an inspection program, ensuring effective participation of the plant management team and timely closure of findings. Conduct regular walk-around checks to monitor HSE controls. Ensure availability of first aid measures and adequate firefighting equipment, including inspection of its status. Collect environmental deviations and ensure identification and implementation of corrective actions. Plan HSE emergency drills, review reports, and follow up on recommendations. Ensure continuous control of identified risks. Provide induction training to new employees, visitors, and contractors/subcontractors. Develop and implement a calibration plan for all apparatus requiring periodic calibration. Ensure the availability of medical facilities and medicines in the ambulance and onsite medical facilities. Monitor the validity of certification of equipment and operator licenses. Perform other HSE duties as assigned by platform management and HSSE Cluster. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. Desired: High diploma. Preferred: Bachelor’s engineering degree. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Rumah (Riyadh Province) and An Nu'ayriyah (Eastern Province), Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with power and water plant operations, ensuring a safe and compliant working environment for all personnel.

642a9dae995ed9f8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة آفاق الغذاء عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يمتلكون المؤهلات المطلوبة للتقديم على هذا الدور ضمن فريق آفاق الغذاء.

64fc1d1fdf8807e0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مستوى السلامة للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على جميع أنشطة الصيانة، بما في ذلك إعداد الخطط والبرامج، وتوزيع المهام على فريق العمل، وتصميم البرامج التدريبية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة إجراءات الصيانة الوقائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصيانة أو دور مشابه. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات جيدة في تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير فرق العمل. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. طريقة التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مستوى السلامة للمقاولات، يرجى التقديم عبر المنصة المخصصة.

64947a3dec764fa2.company_name: مصنع اليمامه لانتاج ابراج الطاقه الكهربائية
64947a3dec764fa2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الجمعية الوطنية لحقوق الإنسان عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة من خلال وسائل الجرافيك المختلفة. سيعمل المصمم على وضع المخططات العامة وتصميم الإنتاج للإعلانات والمجلات وتقارير الشركات وغيرها من المواد الإعلامية المنشورة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التنسيق مع مالكي التصميم (عملاء داخليون أو خارجيون) لفهم الرسالة المراد نقلها، وتحديد المتطلبات، والاتفاق على المنتج النهائي. تطوير مفاهيم التصميم العامة لتلبية احتياجات العميل، وصياغة أسلوب يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المطلوبين. تقديم المشورة الفنية بما يتوافق مع مفاهيم التصميم العامة، وتقديم الإرشادات بشأن المتطلبات الأسلوبية مثل الألوان والصور ونمط النص والمخطط، لضمان توصيل الرسالة بفعالية. تسليم المنتج النهائي للعميل وجمع الملاحظات ودمجها في التصميم عند الحاجة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالمشاريع، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير أفكار إبداعية ومفاهيم تصميمية مبتكرة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق مع العملاء وأصحاب المصلحة. القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية وتوجيه العملاء بشأن أفضل الممارسات التصميمية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المصمم ضمن فريق متخصص في الجمعية الوطنية لحقوق الإنسان، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع متنوعة تخدم أهداف الجمعية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

64dddd4a66cc89e2.description: About the Role Roche is seeking a Health Technology Assessment Evidence Lead to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring timely patient access to medicines by developing and executing health economic strategies. The successful candidate will contribute to demonstrating the value of therapies to national payers and healthcare decision-makers. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and execution of Health Technology Assessment (HTA) and market access evidence strategies, managing end-to-end HTA submissions across Saudi Arabia. Develop local health economic models and adapt global cost-effectiveness models to align with the Saudi Arabian healthcare system. Build and maintain partnerships with national pharmacoeconomic experts, payers, and central assessment bodies to support informed reimbursement decisions. Collaborate with medical, market access, commercial, and global teams to integrate access and value considerations into brand strategy and clinical planning. Translate complex Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) data into scientific value propositions, sharing insights through publications and external consultations. Mentor colleagues on HTA best practices, conduct horizon scanning for pipeline products, and uphold ethical and compliance standards with a patient-centric approach. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a strategic and curious thinker who thrives in collaborative environments. This role requires a passion for connecting science, economics, and patient access, along with an inclusive and coaching mindset. The ability to translate complex data into meaningful healthcare impact is essential. Qualifications and Requirements MSc or PhD in Health Economics or an equivalent discipline, with practical experience in health economic evaluation methods. Deep familiarity with Health Technology Assessment (HTA) and Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) processes in Saudi Arabia. Knowledge of international HTA bodies such as NICE or SMC. Hands-on experience building and adapting health economic models in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas and VBA. Familiarity with statistical tools such as R. Demonstrated ability to craft national reimbursement strategies and translate technical findings into clear, persuasive insights for cross-functional teams and external stakeholders. Strong scientific writing skills. Active use of AI tools in daily workflow to enhance analytical efficiency and insight generation. Work Environment This role is part of a collaborative, purpose-driven team at Roche, focused on shaping health economic strategies. The position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time commitment. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

6485137b939578b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إشراقة سيان لتقديم الوجبات عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى إجراء اختبارات السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير التنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية. وضع برنامج زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق بشكلها النهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق ووفقًا لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات تحليلية قوية في تحليل السوق ودورات حياة المنتج. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

64e9b9453cd32bdf.description: About KBR, Inc. KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovation and collaboration, committed to improving the world responsibly and safely. 643e749054cc129f.description: About Basiqat by Mantis Basiqat by Mantis, part of the Accor Group, is a luxury eco-resort currently in its pre-opening phase in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This position is critical in establishing the resort's commercial systems, distribution channels, pricing structures, and revenue management strategies prior to opening. Establish pricing strategies across all accommodation categories, market segments, distribution channels, and booking periods. Maximize room revenue, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR), and overall profitability. Monitor market demand, booking trends, competitor pricing, seasonality, and market conditions to identify revenue opportunities. Implement dynamic pricing strategies based on demand forecasts, booking pace, and market intelligence. Manage room inventory, availability, restrictions, and rate structures to optimize revenue performance. Evaluate business mix and distribution profitability to support strategic commercial decisions. Collaborate with Sales & Marketing and Food & Beverage teams to identify opportunities for packages, promotions, and ancillary revenue growth. Support the development of total revenue management initiatives across the resort. 649191d27e80c23a.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Data Products and Services Director to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 64b12f00c25dd75b.description: About Mahally: Mahally is Saudi Arabia’s home for local commerce. We bring thousands of Saudi stores — across beauty, fashion, home, food, gifting, electronics, and more — into one marketplace and one app, making it easier for customers to discover and buy from local brands. We’re more than a catalogue. Mahally is a demand engine for Saudi merchants — helping great products get discovered and connecting shoppers with local businesses they may not have found otherwise. About the Role: We’re looking for an SEO Manager to own Mahally’s organic search strategy end-to-end, covering technical SEO, content and organic growth, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/AEO). This is not a keyword-reporting role. Mahally is a large, dynamic marketplace with millions of URLs, constantly changing stores and products, and significant opportunities to improve how search engines crawl, index, understand, and rank our content. You’ll lead the work to strengthen our technical SEO foundation, improve indexation and discoverability, build scalable organic landing-page strategies, and create sustainable organic growth that isn’t dependent on individual merchants or products. You’ll also help shape how Mahally appears across emerging AI and answer engines, including ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google’s AI-powered search experiences. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Content, and Merchant teams , you’ll turn SEO opportunities into clear priorities and measurable business impact. Success will be measured not only by rankings and visibility, but by qualified organic traffic, orders, and GMV. What You'll Do 1- Fix the technical foundation Own technical SEO for a marketplace at scale: crawl budget, indexation, canonicalisation, pagination, faceted navigation, internal linking, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, and JS rendering. Diagnose and resolve index bloat — decide which page types deserve to be indexed at all, and enforce it through robots directives, canonical strategy, and sitemap hygiene. Solve for churn: define what happens to a store or product URL when it disappears, so we stop leaking equity every time a merchant leaves. Partner with Engineering on an SEO backlog that actually ships — with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and measured impact after release. 2- Build organic surfaces that last Design and grow durable page types — category, collection, brand, city, intent, and comparison pages — that don't depend on any single merchant staying. Own the content roadmap for organic: Arabic-first keyword and intent research, briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh cycles. Optimise store and product templates: titles, meta, headings, structured data, on-page copy, and merchandising signals. Build internal linking as a system, not a one-off project. 3- Own AI and answer-engine visibility (GEO/AEO) Define and execute Mahally's strategy for generative and answer engines: crawler access policy, structured data, entity clarity, citable content, and brand presence in AI answers. Make deliberate decisions about which AI crawlers we allow and why — and be able to defend the trade-off between control and visibility. Track and report where Mahally appears in AI answers for commercial Saudi queries, and close the gaps. 4- Measure honestly Own Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and log-file analysis. Build reporting that ties organic to sessions, orders, and GMV — not just impressions. Set up rank, indexation, and coverage monitoring with alerts, so we catch a drop in days rather than a quarter. Run structured tests on page templates and title/meta patterns and report the causal read where you can get one. 5- Work across the business Brief and influence Engineering, Product, and Content without owning their roadmaps. Guide merchants on the content and imagery that make their pages rank and convert. Present organic performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership with a clear point of view and a clear ask. What Success Looks Like You’ll help Mahally build an organic acquisition engine that scales with the marketplace — improving how efficiently our pages are crawled and indexed, increasing qualified organic discovery, creating durable search surfaces, and strengthening Mahally’s presence across both traditional and AI-powered search. Ultimately, your work will translate organic visibility into more customers, more orders, and more growth for Saudi merchants. 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience , with proven experience managing SEO for a large-scale e-commerce platform, marketplace, classifieds site, or other high-volume website . Strong technical SEO expertise , with hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalisation, and site architecture . Proven experience managing SEO for websites with 100K+ indexable URLs/pages , including solving large-scale challenges such as index bloat, faceted navigation, duplicate or thin content, and crawl-budget optimisation . Advanced hands-on experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEO crawling tools such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, and SEO platforms such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent tools . Practical experience implementing, auditing, and optimising structured data/schema markup , particularly for e-commerce, including Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, Organization, or similar schemas. Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English , with the ability to conduct Arabic keyword and search-intent research and assess the quality and relevance of Arabic SEO content. Strong analytical and commercial mindset , with the ability to quantify SEO opportunities, prioritise initiatives based on potential impact, and measure results across organic traffic, conversions, and business outcomes. Proven experience partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams to translate SEO findings into clear technical requirements and successfully deliver SEO improvements at scale. Nice to Have Experience with GEO/AEO and AI-powered search discovery . SQL, Python, or scripting experience for log analysis, bulk SEO audits, or automated monitoring. Experience with multilingual SEO, including hreflang and Arabic/English content strategies. Experience with App Store Optimization (ASO) or web-to-app discovery. Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the GCC , with an understanding of local search and consumer behaviour. Digital PR, authority-building, or regional link-acquisition experience.

643afc28db1e6917.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes. As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem. Why this role matters At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and own problems from beginning to end . You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration. You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers . You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption. What You'll Do Own design problems end-to-end. You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration. Turn ambiguity into clarity. Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve. Design for outcomes, not outputs. You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working. Partner closely with Product and Engineering. You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer. Raise the quality of our products. You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different. Bring customer evidence into design decisions. You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion. Make complex products feel simple. Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster. Design thoughtfully for our market. You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region. Communicate your thinking clearly. You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only what you designed but why you made those decisions. Make the team better. You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area. Who You Are You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step. You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward. You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer. You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished. You're comfortable challenging the status quo. If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence. You know when to push and when to compromise. You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints. You're highly collaborative. You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process. You're comfortable with ambiguity and change. Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process. You're genuinely curious about users. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong. You communicate with clarity. You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive. You care about quality. You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when “good enough to learn” is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated. You have 3–5 years of product design or UX/UI experience , ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking. You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices. You're a Saudi national , as this position is designated for Saudi nationals. Nice to Have Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products. Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents. Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences. Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools. Design interview — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems. Portfolio / case study presentation — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes. Team / culture interview — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team.
